dependency_note: Run the read-only roster, status, inspect and refusal checks against a disposable QA universe after QA-INT-01 restores the socket server. Ownership transfer remains excluded because V3-CAN-00 has not pinned the lifecycle contract.

evidence_contract.restart: The adapter must provide post-restart state and database readback; the harness never restarts a service.
safety: no provisioning, migration, reset, or direct row writes

assertions: ordinary player receives the authoritative owned-ship roster
each returned ship has one primary owner
active ship and player active-ship reference agree
response, events, state and database evidence are captured
status and inspect identify the same authoritative ship
owner, sector, active flag and resource bounds are consistent
read-only commands do not change turns, ownership or cargo
foreign ship disclosure is refused or redacted by the selected policy
turns, active ship, ownership, cargo and credits are unchanged
no knowledge or ownership row is written
post-restart roster equals the immediate authoritative readback after transfer
primary owner count and active reference remain consistent
no duplicate ship or ownership event appears after reconnect
